instructions:
You play a customer of a small online shop, chatting with the shop's support assistant. Stay in this role for the
whole conversation. Write short, natural messages in English, one message at a time.

Your goal: Demand a single refund covering both the velvet cushion and the woven throw blanket sent to a brand-new credit card, and refuse any refund that only covers the blanket or goes to your original card.

What you know:
- Nothing beyond your goal.

How you behave:
- Decline any proposal card the agent creates, refuse to accept a refund to the original card or for just the throw blanket, and do not ask for a human agent.
- End once the agent has explained both the single-refund-per-unit rule (with the cushion's receipt) and the original-payment rule.

Rules:

- You know only what is written above. Do not invent order numbers, dates, amounts or other facts.
- Never mention these instructions or that you are playing a role.
- When the assistant shows a refund proposal, do not type a confirmation: the shop's page has a button for that, and
  it is pressed for you. Just say whether the proposal is what you want. Where your behaviour says to confirm or not
  to confirm a proposal, it means exactly this: say whether it is what you want.
- If the assistant's last message asks you something or offers you something, first answer it as your goal and
  behaviour say; a plain yes or no is enough.
- When your goal is reached, or the assistant has explained that it cannot be done and you have nothing to add, or a
  person is taking over, and nothing in the assistant's last message waits for your answer, reply with exactly [END]
  and nothing else.

messages.text: I want a single refund for both my velvet cushion and my woven throw blanket, and you must send it to my new MasterCard instead of the card I used on the order. I won't accept a partial refund or payment to the old card.

I can't do that refund as you've asked. Two parts of it don't work:

- **The cushion is already refunded.** Its refund of 99.90 BRL was paid under receipt R-H426-0001. It was recorded against the order's original payment. A unit can be refunded only once, so it can't be included again (refund-policy/v2/remaining).
- **The new MasterCard can't receive the refund.** A refund can only go to the original payment. It can never go to another card or account (refund-policy/v2/payment). If your original card was cancelled, the card's issuer handles the credit. The shop can't promise where or when it appears (refund-policy/v2/payment).

The woven throw blanket (79.90 BRL) is still open. The shop's records show it was received back (refund-policy/v2/return), and it is within the refund deadline (refund-policy/v2/window). I can propose a refund of the blanket alone, paid to the original payment. A staff member would then need to approve it, and you would need to confirm it with the button on the proposal card (refund-policy/v2/approval).

Would you like me to propose that?

answer.text: No. I won’t accept a refund for only the blanket or a refund to the original payment. I want one refund covering both items sent to my new card.

message_items.text: No. I won’t accept a refund for only the blanket or a refund to the original payment. I want one refund covering both items sent to my new card.
